description: This is a Java source file containing a class called ConceptValidator that performs validation for Concept objects within the OpenMRS project. It enforces rules on concept names, concept mappings, and other attributes to ensure data integrity within the application.

classes.name: ConceptValidator
classes.description: A class implementing Spring's Validator interface for validating Concept objects, ensuring each concept meets specific criteria regarding names, mappings, and other attributes before being persisted or updated.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the validator supports validating objects of the specified class; returns true if the class is Concept or a subclass.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of a Concept object, checking for duplicate names, proper naming conventions, associated mappings, and attribute length constraints, and registers errors accordingly.
